items.title: Mangaluru child sexual assault: Church hierarchy knew of allegations weeks before FIR
items.summary: A Catholic priest in Mangaluru, Karnataka, was arrested on Saturday, October 17, for allegedly sexually abusing minor children. Although the arrest comes two days after a First Information Report was registered against the priest, officials of the Mangalore Diocese, including the Bishop, were aware of the allegations for almost two months. Father Cyprian Pinto of St Vincent Ferrer Church in Valencia was arrested by the Mangaluru South police from the residence of his relative, Police Commissioner Sudheer Kumar Reddy said. Father Cyprian faces a case registered under Sections 8 (sexual assault) and 10 (aggravated sexual assault) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, and Section 75(2) (sexual harassment) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. A community member and an activist told TNM that the matter was brought to the attention of Bishop Peter Paul Saladanha on August 17. Section 19 of the POCSO Act makes it mandatory that any person with knowledge of a sexual offence against a child must bring it to the notice of the authorities.
